title: Public access to legal material in official electronic record.
bodyText: An official publisher of legal material in an electronic record that is required to be preserved under section 98-7 shall ensure that the material is reasonably available for use by the public on a permanent basis.
bodyHtml: [§98-8]  Public access to legal material in official electronic record.  An official publisher of legal material in an electronic record that is required to be preserved under section 98-7 shall ensure that the material is reasonably available for use by the public on a permanent basis. [L 2013, c 11, pt of §1]
